p.d: The human world has spread to every corner of the globe. Wildlife must adapt to a vastly altered landscape and contend directly with us. Long-tailed macaques have learned to steal tourists' precious items and barter for their favourite food. Rhinos and black bears walk through the streets to find food. The major challenge is reimagining the way we live to find ways to protect all life on earth.

In this episode, we're going to learn that jealousy exists in the animal world too; cows are easily entertained; food tastes a little better when danger is involved; snakes are very clean animals; dolphins don't like certain surfers; and also find out who's winning one grand this time.

p.d: Disorganisation is usually a weakness, but in the Australian animal kingdom it is the opposite. This episode explores how being DISORGANISED works in our fauna's favour. kookaburra families, flying fox colonies and Tasmanian devil broods all show how a chaotic approach to life can help a species get ahead in a land of extremes.

The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

Exorcist Liu Yi Ze proposes marriage to his girlfriend, but discovers that her family is manipulated by the Fox Demon. During his fight with the Fox Demon who has possessed his masters body, Liu Yi Ze must defeat the Fox Demon without hurting his master. Can he vanquish the demon and safeguard everyone?

In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

Xu finds himself trapped inside an iron box after awaking from a coma. As the box opens, he finds himself in a tropical forest together with other survivors, all not knowing how they ended up there. Not only do they have to face various crisis and attacks from beasts, they also have to uncover the truth behind it all so as to escape from danger.

Young and innocent Qing Cheng is trained to become a ruthless killer to seek vengeance for her family. After killing many, she decides to let go of her resentment and seeks refuge in a remote village, where she meets Bang and marries him. As social upheaval erupts, Qing has to step up again to protect the village and restore peace.

Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

Ling Long Town faces frequent natural disasters. Rumour has it that feeding the dragon in the well with children will help. A new imperial scholar wants to investigate the well but is imprisoned for allegedly offending the Dragon Emperor. Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

p.t: You Can Cook With Sam Kim #12
p.d: Star chef Sam Kim will teach you how to make all kinds of delicious dishes – from Italian pasta, Spanish food to desserts! Follow his easy recipes and enjoy cooking!
The cast travels to new locations to experience seaside life, working at local jobs and cooking authentic meals with fresh, seasonal ingredients in this heartwarming reality show.

Lee Kwang-soo and Doh Kyung-soo are reuniting to open a cafeteria inside the production company eggiscoming. What kind of meals will they prepare using the newly harvested potatoes from 3 Meals A Day: Light?
Ryu Soo-young, Yoon Kyung-ho and Kihyun set out into the unknown for new recipes, cooking up one-of-a-kind dishes along the way.
3 Meals A Day returns on its 10th anniversary. Cha Seung-won and Yoo Hae-jin will experience a self-sufficient village life again and enjoy simple yet fulfilling meals with surprise guests.
